mentions.h: I ONLY HAVE EYES FOR YOU!

photos.c: I ONLY HAVE EYES FOR YOU! (Photo:R.Linstead).Ron Clarke and Geoff North exchange looks just after the start of the 5000m invitation at Crystal Palace on June 22nd. Winner was Sawake (7) from Gamoudi (12) and Clarke (1). Geoff finished 9th in 13:54.6 (!) only 18.4 seconds behind the winner.
